outcome: Maternal complications during pregnancy (hypertension, pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, etc.)
Renal function (serum creatinine) during pregnancy and postpartum
Blood pressure changes during pregnancy and postpartum
cohort: 22 women with kidney transplantation who had at least one pregnancy (totaling 25 pregnancies) between January 1995 and December 2017
finding: Pre-eclampsia and prematurity were frequent complications in pregnancies after kidney transplantation, and cesarean section rates were very high.
mod_finding: A total of 88.2% of the women delivered by cesarean section.
